challenged_statement: For a fixed rank-three spectral core Q3 and scalar spectral remainder Q_rest, the bare QFORM hypotheses force sup_b ||p_{Q3|Q_rest=b}||_infinity to be universally bounded.
counterexample: X1,...,X4 iid Uniform[-1/2,1/2], Y1=(X1+X4)/sqrt(2), Y4=(X1-X4)/sqrt(2), Y2=X2, Y3=X3, Q3=Y1^2+Y2^2-Y3^2, Q_rest=2Y4^2. The total form has eigenvalues {2,1,1,-1}. For b=2s^2 and delta=1/sqrt(2)-s, Y1|Q_rest=b is Uniform[-delta,delta], and p_{Q3|Q_rest=b}(0) >= [log(1/(8 delta^2))+2]/sqrt(2) -> infinity.
not_refuted: The QFORM conjecture. In the same example the full Q has a bounded continuous density with ||p_Q||_infinity <= pi/sqrt(2), because the (X1,X4) positive-definite block has determinant 2 and is independent of X2^2-X3^2. Scalar conditioning may still be useful if the averaging over b is retained; only the uniform conditional-supremum bridge is refuted.
replacement: QFORM-DETERMINANT-BANK-HALF-RIESZ-v1 aggregates cross minors before reciprocal payment and yields a weighted integrated-time/half-Riesz criterion for linear small-ball scaling.
